Cycle tour Innradweg Innsbruck Tourismus

Difficulty ratings: easy
Route length: 28.8 km
Duration: 1:45 h

Choose tour stage:

Innradweg Stage 5: Zillertal - Kufstein/Kiefersfelden (D) Inn cycle path Tirol Innradweg Tirol Innradweg Innsbruck Tourismus Innradweg TVB Silberregion Karwendel Innradweg Ötztal

The third stage of the Innradweg leads along family-friendly paths to the Tyrolean capital in no time at all. Many sights await you here.

Tour character

Short, family-friendly cycle tour from Telfs to the Tyrolean capital. Numerous classic Tyrolean sights await you in Innsbruck. From the Golden Roof to the Imperial Palace and a ride on the Hungerburgbahn up the Hafelekar.

Tour information

  • Requirement: easy
  • Length: 28.8 km
  • Duration: 1:45 h
  • Elevation uphill:136 hm
  • Elevation downhill:187 hm
